title: session_start.sh 黑洞风险防 (watchdog + fail-closed)
acceptance_criteria: scripts/heartbeat-watchdog.sh: 监控 session_start 耗时, > 5s 报警 + kill
scripts/lib/session-start-safety.sh: 启动前 5 项 safety check (portable)
1. fd 0/1/2 全部指向 tty 或 file, 不指向 pipe
session_start.sh 集成: 启动前调用 session-start-safety.sh, 失败 fail-closed (exit 1 + 明确错误)
fail-closed 测试: 模拟 fd 指向 pipe, 验证 session_start 立即退出不 hang
notes: 黑洞重演的最强防御. watchdog 监控 + fail-closed safety check 双保险
